zh-CN.title: LightRAG
zh-CN.description: 从 LightRAG 检索文档与实体关系，并使用统一的来源引用。

usage.title: 在对话中提出检索问题
usage.description: 让 Agent 查询已连接知识库中的文档、实体或实体间关系。

usage.title: 查看来源依据
usage.description: 检查结果的文档引用；实体关系只展示服务返回的边，有文档片段支持时才提供对应引用。

requirements: 管理员已配置 LightRAG 连接、凭据、用户绑定和相关检索工具。

en-US.title: LightRAG
en-US.description: Retrieve documents and entity relations from LightRAG with shared source citations.

usage.title: Ask a retrieval question
usage.description: Ask the Agent to search the connected knowledge base for documents, entities or relationships.

usage.title: Inspect supporting sources
usage.description: Check document citations. Relations reflect returned edges and receive document citations only when supporting excerpts are available.

requirements: The administrator must configure the LightRAG connection, credentials, user bindings and retrieval tools.
